about_the_game:
Descend into Tiny Crypts, a roguelike deckbuilding dungeon crawler where every card is a weapon that can be upgraded and enchanted! Wield swords, spells and more as you craft your deck, retrieve loot, and battle unique enemies.

---

  • In Tiny Crypts, you must craft powerful cards to overcome ever-changing crypts.

  • Each crypt is procedurally generated, offering new enemies, layouts, and challenges. Choose your path wisely, will you risk the tougher route for better loot or play it safe to prepare for the final boss?

  • Discover rare cards and potions to forge cards with unique effects. Experiment with combinations to create devastating synergies

  • Outsmart enemies, build your deck, and craft the ultimate weapon to defeat the dungeon’s mysterious overlords. Victory is yours - if you can survive.

---

Featuring:

  • 10+ Crypt Events

  • 20+ Enemies

  • 30+ Customisable Cards

  • 135+ Combat encounters

  • Daily Descent which presents a unique challenge each day

---

A stunning hand-drawn adventure crafted by an artist with experience at Warner Brothers, Titmouse, Cartoon Network, and Marvel. There are over 10 fully hand-drawn backgrounds, nearly 20 hand drawn enemies, and close to 100 unique cards.
